{{Top|leg}}
'''IntelTechs''' were members of [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]] who conducted background checks on potential [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] recruits. They were known to have cleared [[Ben Spax]] despite the man being an enigma who was rumored to have found the Rebellion on his own.
